title: Site-specific effects of acetylation within the histone H3 tail on liquid-liquid phase separation with DNA
authors: Masahiro Mimura; Hiroka Sugai; Tomoshi Kameda; Ryo Kitahara; Soichiro Kitazawa; Yoichi Shinkai; Ryoji Kurita; Shunsuke Tomita
one_liner_zh: 该文通过实验和MD模拟研究组蛋白H3尾部乙酰化位点对H3肽与DNA液-液相分离的影响，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系，虽非典型TF-DNA，但MD方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Post-translational modifications (PTMs) of histone proteins play a pivotal role in the regulation of chromatin condensation, with evidence increasingly pointing to the involvement of liquid–liquid phase separation (LLPS). Here, we report the significant impact of the acetylation site of the N-terminal histone H3 peptide on LLPS with nucleosomal-linker DNA. In our model system, which mimics a part of the structure of chromatin, non-acetylated H3 peptide and DNA undergo LLPS, driven primarily by electrostatic interactions. Acetylation of the H3 peptide significantly inhibits LLPS, with the inhibitory effects varying markedly depending on the acetylation site. Specifically, acetylation near the ends of the 20-residue H3 peptide (i.e., H3K4ac and H3K18ac) results in stronger inhibition of LLPS compared to acetylation near the center (i.e., H3K9ac and H3K14ac). Through experiments (circular dichroism and interaction assays using salts and 1,6-hexanediol) and molecular-dynamics (MD) simulations, it was revealed that differences in the DNA thermal stability, hydrophobic effects, and charge distribution of the H3 peptides/DNA complexes underlie this phenomenon. Our findings provide fundamental insights that link LLPS-mediated chromatin condensation to various biological phenomena depending on the acetylation sites on the histone proteins, thus shedding light on the mechanisms of gene regulation.
abstract_zh: 组蛋白的翻译后修饰（PTMs）在染色质凝缩调控中扮演关键角色，越来越多的证据指向液-液相分离（LLPS）的参与。在此，我们报道了N端组蛋白H3肽段乙酰化位点对与核小体连接DNA发生LLPS的显著影响。在我们的模型系统中，该模型模拟了染色质结构的一部分，非乙酰化H3肽段与DNA发生LLPS，主要由静电相互作用驱动。H3肽段的乙酰化显著抑制LLPS，且抑制效果因乙酰化位点不同而显著变化。具体而言，位于20残基H3肽段末端附近的乙酰化（即H3K4ac和H3K18ac）相比中心附近的乙酰化（即H3K9ac和H3K14ac）对LLPS的抑制作用更强。通过实验（圆二色光谱法以及使用盐和1,6-己二醇的相互作用测定）和分子动力学（MD）模拟，揭示了DNA热稳定性、疏水效应以及H3肽段/DNA复合物电荷分布的差异是这一现象的基础。我们的发现提供了基础性见解，将LLPS介导的染色质凝缩与依赖于组蛋白上乙酰化位点的多种生物现象联系起来，从而阐明了基因调控的机制。
